crossRefs.note: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
After all this Yahweh struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
In process of time, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of severe…
My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my…

translations.web: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
translations.bsb: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
translations.kjv: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
translations.asv: For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh.
